scope: Spline nominal shard 1 only: 3D Bayesian acceptance histograms in fit_copy.root, all Q2-y bins 1-17 (452 cells). RC_Bayesian and BC_RC_Bayesian are absent and were not created. The shard remake was python3 Systematic_Studies/sidis_physics_cli.py run_shard -p nominal -s 1 -w Systematic_Studies/physics_campaign/work_plan.json, which reused the existing fit. The guide remake was Q2-y 1,3,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12,13,14,15 only.
start_mode: manual. Spline B/C windows are tight (median B width 0.02, 945 of 1390 B windows narrower than 0.05), so the automatic choice does not pass --use_spline_init. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of the manual initializer with only those keys overridden.
changed: The first-pass moment start was too small, and the second pass only moves each parameter by half of that result, so the curve missed the phi modulation. Starts were moved to the histogram minimum and limits that excluded it were widened. The shared manual file and the universal spline file were not edited. left_bins: This file has no 5D histograms, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. (13,10) was left at B -0.274 and C 0.108 instead of being pulled toward the nearly flat z-pT 11 neighbor.
